note: Curation applied on top of the research files. 'rename' maps research ids onto stable ids: the shared/patterns.ts v0 ids (kept so eval scenarios and tool enums keep working) and four near-duplicates that two research agents both wrote (their lists are merged, India entry first). 'twins' pairs global patterns with the Indian pattern describing the same mechanism; evaluation reports pattern accuracy both strictly and with twins counted as a match.

mule_account_recruitment.truth_en: Letting anyone use your bank account or SIM for money makes you part of the crime, and police arrest account sellers.

loan_processing_fee.truth_en: A genuine lender never asks for a fee into a personal account before giving you a loan.

aeps_biometric_misuse.truth_en: You can lock your Aadhaar biometrics on the UIDAI website or mAadhaar app so nobody can use your fingerprint to withdraw money.
aeps_biometric_misuse.provenance_note: No official advisory for this pattern could be opened during research (Oct 2026); it rests on credible news reports. Treat as lower-confidence until an official source is added.

ai_voice_clone_emergency.truth_en: Voices can be cloned with AI, so please hang up and call your family member yourself on their usual number before paying.

apk_malware_invite.truth_en: Banks, government schemes and traffic police never send apps as APK files on WhatsApp; please don't install it, and uninstall it if you did.
apk_malware_invite.provenance_note: No official advisory for this pattern could be opened during research (Oct 2026); it rests on credible news reports. Treat as lower-confidence until an official source is added.

bank_fraud_dept_impersonation.truth_en: Your bank will never ask you to move money to a 'safe account' or to share an OTP or PIN to protect it.

betting_gaming_app.truth_en: Online money games and betting apps are banned in India under the 2025 online gaming law, so any app taking money for bets is illegal.

boss_impersonation_whatsapp.truth_en: Before paying on a WhatsApp or e-mail instruction from a senior person, call them yourself on their known number to confirm.

credit_card_limit_or_fee.truth_en: Your bank never asks for an OTP, CVV or PIN, or for an app install, to change a card limit or fee; do it only in the bank's official app or helpline.

credit_card_reward_points.truth_en: Reward points are redeemed only in your card issuer's official app or website; issuers never send APK files or ask for OTP, CVV or PIN.

crypto_investment.truth_en: No genuine investment platform makes you pay a fee or tax to withdraw your own money.

e_challan_apk.truth_en: Traffic challans never come as an app file; check and pay challans only on the official Parivahan website.
e_challan_apk.provenance_note: No official advisory for this pattern could be opened during research (Oct 2026); it rests on credible news reports. Treat as lower-confidence until an official source is added.

epfo_pf_withdrawal.truth_en: All EPFO services are free on the EPFO portal and the UMANG app; never pay an agent to get your PF.

fake_charity_disaster.truth_en: Donate only through the official website or verified account of the relief fund or temple, not a QR code or UPI ID sent in a message.

fake_ecommerce_site.truth_en: If an online offer looks too good to be true it usually is; you can check a website or number on cybercrime.gov.in before paying.

fake_job_offer_fee.truth_en: A genuine employer never asks you to pay for a job, an offer letter or training.

foreign_gift_customs.truth_en: Indian Customs never asks you to pay duty into a personal bank account over a call, text or e-mail.

franchise_dealership.truth_en: Never pay a franchise or dealership fee unless you have verified the offer directly on the company's official website.

govt_scheme_subsidy.truth_en: Government schemes never ask you to pay a fee into a private account or to share an OTP; check schemes only on official .gov.in portals.

hacked_account_friend_request.truth_en: Accounts get hacked, so call your friend on their known number before sending money asked for in a chat.

income_tax_refund.truth_en: The Income Tax Department never sends refund links; refunds go only to the bank account you validate yourself on incometax.gov.in.

insurance_policy_bonus.truth_en: IRDAI warns never to pay or share policy, bank or OTP details on calls or messages that use its name.

lpg_gas_connection.truth_en: Gas companies never ask for OTPs, bank details or app installs on calls or WhatsApp; book and do KYC only in the official app.
lpg_gas_connection.provenance_note: No official advisory for this pattern could be opened during research (Oct 2026); it rests on credible news reports. Treat as lower-confidence until an official source is added.

loan_app_harassment.truth_en: Borrow only from banks or RBI-regulated lenders, and report threats or morphed photos to the police on 1930 instead of paying.

matrimonial_fraud.truth_en: Never send money to someone you met only on a matrimonial site, whatever the reason, before meeting and verifying them in person.

mobile_tower_installation.truth_en: TRAI does not charge any fee or issue NOCs for mobile tower installation, so don't pay anyone who says it does.

pension_life_certificate.truth_en: The Central Pension Accounting Office never calls pensioners about life certificates or asks for OTPs; submit it at your bank or through Jeevan Pramaan.

ponzi_deposit_scheme.truth_en: Deposit schemes promising high fixed returns without a financial regulator's registration are illegal under the BUDS Act, and your money is not protected.
ponzi_deposit_scheme.provenance_note: No official advisory for this pattern could be opened during research (Oct 2026); it rests on credible news reports. Treat as lower-confidence until an official source is added.

romance_social_media.truth_en: Never send money to someone you have only met online, however urgent their story.

scholarship_fee.truth_en: Scholarships are applied for on the National Scholarship Portal; no genuine scheme asks for a fee or an OTP over the phone.

sim_swap_esim.truth_en: Telecom companies never need your OTP or a link click to upgrade your SIM or activate an eSIM; do it only at the operator's store or app.

travel_pilgrimage_booking.truth_en: Kedarnath helicopter tickets are sold only on the official IRCTC website; fake sites and ads target pilgrims.

rent_advance_landlord.truth_en: You never need to enter your UPI PIN or approve a request to receive money; a real tenant or landlord won't ask for that.

wrong_transfer_return.truth_en: An SMS is not proof of money received; check your balance in your bank app and never 'return' money to a stranger.
wrong_transfer_return.provenance_note: No official advisory for this pattern could be opened during research (Oct 2026); it rests on credible news reports. Treat as lower-confidence until an official source is added.

fake_cybercrime_legal_notice.truth_en: No police or government agency sends crime notices by e-mail asking you to reply or pay; PIB Fact Check has confirmed these notices are fake.
fake_cybercrime_legal_notice.provenance_note: No official advisory for this pattern could be opened during research (Oct 2026); it rests on credible news reports. Treat as lower-confidence until an official source is added.

rbi_fictitious_funds.truth_en: RBI never holds money or prizes for individuals, and never calls or e-mails asking for fees or personal details.
